{"timestamp":"2026-04-02T09:17:19.388Z","hook_event_name":"PreToolUse","session_id":"4dc40a1e-da88-41ae-82da-245abcbba130","transcript_path":"c:\\Users\\misla\\AppData\\Roaming\\Code\\User\\workspaceStorage\\f442918b69b7be1a95b300561227d406\\GitHub.copilot-chat\\transcripts\\4dc40a1e-da88-41ae-82da-245abcbba130.jsonl","tool_name":"create_file","tool_input":{"filePath":"c:\\Users\\misla\\source\\repos\\manage-my-hairsaloon\\Models\\README.md","content":"# Hair Salon Management System - Data Models\n\nThis document explains all the models (entities) in the Hair Salon Management System and their relationships.\n\n## Overview\n\nThe system consists of 7 core models organized into:\n- **User Management**: User, UserRole\n- **Business**: HairSalon, Staff, Service, ServiceCategory\n- **Bookings**: Reservation, ReservationStatus\n- **Reviews**: Review\n\n---\n\n## Models\n\n### 1. User\n**Purpose**: Represents all users in the system (customers, staff, admins)\n\n**Properties**:\n```csharp\npublic int Id { get; set; }\npublic string Email { get; set; }\npublic string PasswordHash { get; set; }\npublic string FirstName { get; set; }\npublic string LastName { get; set; }\npublic string PhoneNumber { get; set; }\npublic UserRole Role { get; set; }  // Enum: Customer, Staff, Admin\npublic DateTime CreatedAt { get; set; }\n```\n\n**Navigation Properties** (Related Data):\n- `Staff` - If user is staff, links to Staff entity (1-to-1)\n- `CustomerReservations` - Reservations made by this customer (1-to-many)\n- `Reviews` - Reviews written by this customer (1-to-many)\n\n**Example**:\n```csharp\nvar user = new User \n{ \n    FirstName = \"John\", \n    Email = \"john@email.com\", \n    Role = UserRole.Customer \n};\n```\n\n---\n\n### 2. UserRole (Enum)\n**Purpose**: Defines the role/type of user\n\n**Values**:\n```csharp\nCustomer  // Can book reservations\nStaff     // Works at salon\nAdmin     // Manages salon\n```\n\n**Usage**:\n```csharp\nif (user.Role == UserRole.Staff) { /* staff only logic */ }\n```\n\n---\n\n### 3. HairSalon\n**Purpose**: Represents a physical hair salon location\n\n**Properties**:\n```csharp\npublic int Id { get; set; }\npublic string Name { get; set; }\npublic string Address { get; set; }\npublic string PhoneNumber { get; set; }\npublic string Email { get; set; }\npublic DateTime CreatedAt { get; set; }\n```\n\n**Navigation Properties**:\n- `Staff` - All staff members working at this salon (1-to-many)\n- `Services` - All services offered by this salon (1-to-many)\n\n**Relationships**:\n- ONE salon has MANY staff members\n- ONE salon has MANY services\n\n**Example**:\n```csharp\nvar salon = new HairSalon \n{ \n    Name = \"Premium Cuts Downtown\", \n    Address = \"123 Main Street\" \n};\nsalon.Staff.Add(staffMember);\nsalon.Services.Add(service);\n```\n\n---\n\n### 4. Staff\n**Purpose**: Represents a staff member at a salon\n\n**Properties**:\n```csharp\npublic int Id { get; set; }\npublic int UserId { get; set; }              // Foreign Key\npublic int HairSalonId { get; set; }         // Foreign Key\npublic string Specialization { get; set; }   // e.g., \"Hair Coloring\"\npublic decimal HourlyRate { get; set; }\npublic bool IsAvailable { get; set; }\n```\n\n**Navigation Properties**:\n- `User` - Links to User entity (1-to-1)\n- `HairSalon` - Links to HairSalon entity (many-to-1)\n- `Reservations` - All reservations for this staff member (1-to-many)\n\n**Relationships**:\n- ONE user can be ONE staff member (one-to-one)\n- MANY staff members work at ONE salon (many-to-one)\n- ONE staff member has MANY reservations (one-to-many)\n\n**Example**:\n```csharp\nvar staff = new Staff \n{ \n    UserId = 5,\n    HairSalonId = 1,\n    Specialization = \"Hair Coloring\",\n    HourlyRate = 50m\n};\n```\n\n---\n\n### 5. Service\n**Purpose**: Represents a service offered by a salon\n\n**Properties**:\n```csharp\npublic int Id { get; set; }\npublic int HairSalonId { get; set; }         // Foreign Key\npublic string Name { get; set; }\npublic string Description { get; set; }\npublic decimal Price { get; set; }\npublic int DurationMinutes { get; set; }\npublic ServiceCategory Category { get; set; }  // Enum\n```\n\n**Navigation Properties**:\n- `HairSalon` - Salon offering this service (many-to-1)\n- `Reservations` - All reservations for this service (1-to-many)\n\n**Relationships**:\n- MANY services belong to ONE salon (many-to-one)\n- ONE service has MANY reservations (one-to-many)\n\n**Example**:\n```csharp\nvar service = new Service \n{ \n    HairSalonId = 1,\n    Name = \"Hair Coloring\",\n    Price = 120m,\n    DurationMinutes = 120,\n    Category = ServiceCategory.Coloring\n};\n```\n\n---\n\n### 6. ServiceCategory (Enum)\n**Purpose**: Categorizes types of services\n\n**Values**:\n```csharp\nHairCut\nColoring\nStyling\nTreatment\nBeard\nNails\nFacialTreatment\n```\n\n**Usage**:\n```csharp\nif (service.Category == ServiceCategory.HairCut) { /* ... */ }\n```\n\n---\n\n### 7. Reservation\n**Purpose**: Represents a booking made by a customer\n\n**Properties**:\n```csharp\npublic int Id { get; set; }\npublic int CustomerId { get; set; }          // Foreign Key (User)\npublic int StaffId { get; set; }             // Foreign Key\npublic int ServiceId { get; set; }           // Foreign Key\npublic DateTime ReservationDateTime { get; set; }\npublic ReservationStatus Status { get; set; }  // Enum\npublic string Notes { get; set; }\npublic DateTime CreatedAt { get; set; }\n```\n\n**Navigation Properties**:\n- `Customer` - The customer making the reservation (many-to-1 User)\n- `Staff` - Staff member assigned to reservation (many-to-1)\n- `Service` - Service being booked (many-to-1)\n- `Reviews` - Reviews for this reservation (1-to-many)\n\n**Relationships**:\n- MANY reservations belong to ONE customer (many-to-one with User)\n- MANY reservations assigned to ONE staff (many-to-one)\n- MANY reservations for ONE service (many-to-one)\n- ONE reservation has MANY reviews (one-to-many)\n\n**Example**:\n```csharp\nvar reservation = new Reservation \n{ \n    CustomerId = 1,\n    StaffId = 2,\n    ServiceId = 3,\n    ReservationDateTime = new DateTime(2026, 4, 5, 10, 0, 0),\n    Status = ReservationStatus.Confirmed,\n    Notes = \"First time customer\"\n};\n```\n\n---\n\n### 8. ReservationStatus (Enum)\n**Purpose**: Tracks the status of a reservation\n\n**Values**:\n```csharp\nPending      // Waiting for confirmation\nConfirmed    // Confirmed appointment\nCompleted    // Service completed\nCancelled    // Customer cancelled\nNoShow       // Customer didn't show up\n```\n\n**Usage**:\n```csharp\nvar confirmed = reservations\n    .Where(r => r.Status == ReservationStatus.Confirmed)\n    .ToList();\n```\n\n---\n\n### 9. Review\n**Purpose**: Customer reviews for completed services\n\n**Properties**:\n```csharp\npublic int Id { get; set; }\npublic int ReservationId { get; set; }       // Foreign Key\npublic int CustomerId { get; set; }          // Foreign Key (User)\npublic int Rating { get; set; }              // 1-5 stars\npublic string Comment { get; set; }\npublic DateTime CreatedAt { get; set; }\n```\n\n**Navigation Properties**:\n- `Reservation` - The reservation being reviewed (many-to-1)\n- `Customer` - The customer who wrote the review (many-to-1 User)\n\n**Relationships**:\n- MANY reviews for ONE reservation (many-to-one)\n- MANY reviews written by ONE customer (many-to-one with User)\n\n**Example**:\n```csharp\nvar review = new Review \n{ \n    ReservationId = 5,\n    CustomerId = 1,\n    Rating = 5,\n    Comment = \"Excellent service!\"\n};\n```\n\n---\n\n## Entity Relationship Diagram\n\n```\nUser (1) ‘ˆ«‘ˆ«‘ˆ«‘ˆ«‘ˆ«‘ˆ«‘ÊÂ (1) Staff ‘ˆ«‘ˆ«‘ˆ«‘ˆ«‘ˆ«‘ˆ«‘ÊÂ (1) HairSalon\n  ‘Ê≈                     ‘ÊÙ\n  ‘ˆÈ              (many) Reservations\n  ‘ˆÈ                     ‘ÊÙ\n  ‘ˆˆ‘ˆ«‘ˆ«‘ˆ«‘ˆ«‘ˆ«‘ˆ«‘ˆ«‘ˆ«‘ˆ«‘ˆ«‘ˆ«‘ˆ«‘ˆ«‘ˆ«‘ˆ«‘ˆ«‘ˆ«‘ˆ«‘ˆ«‘ˆ«‘ˆ«‘ˆ+‘ˆ«‘ˆ«‘ˆ«‘ˆ«‘ˆ«‘ˆ«‘ˆ«‘ˆ«‘ˆ«‘ÊÂ (1) Service\n\nReservation (1) ‘ˆ«‘ˆ«‘ˆ«‘ˆ«‘ˆ«‘ˆ«‘ÊÂ (many) Reviews\n                              ‘ÊÙ\n                         Links to User & Reservation\n```\n\n**Detailed Relationships**:\n\n```\nHairSalon (1) ‘ˆ«‘ˆ«‘ˆ«‘ˆ«‘ˆ«‘ˆ«‘ˆ«‘ˆ«‘ÊÂ (many) Staff\n                              ‘ÊÙ\n                        Works at salon\n                        \n            ‘ˆ«‘ˆ«‘ˆ«‘ˆ«‘ˆ«‘ˆ«‘ˆ«‘ˆ«‘ÊÂ (many) Services\n                     Offered by salon\n\nStaff (1) ‘ˆ«‘ˆ«‘ˆ«‘ˆ«‘ˆ«‘ˆ«‘ÊÂ (many) Reservations\n                    ‘ÊÙ\nUser (Customer) ‘ˆ«‘Ê…‘ˆ« Reservation ‘ˆ«‘ÊÂ Service\n(1)        (many)        ‘ÊÙ\n                    (1) Review (many)\n```\n\n---\n\n## Key Relationships Summary\n\n| From | To | Type | Meaning |\n|------|----|----|---------|\n| User | Staff | 1-to-1 | A user can be one staff member |\n| User | Reservation | 1-to-many | A customer can have many reservations |\n| User | Review | 1-to-many | A customer can write many reviews |\n| HairSalon | Staff | 1-to-many | A salon has many staff members |\n| HairSalon | Service | 1-to-many | A salon offers many services |\n| Staff | Reservation | 1-to-many | A staff member has many reservations |\n| Service | Reservation | 1-to-many | A service can have many reservations |\n| Reservation | Review | 1-to-many | A reservation can have many reviews |\n\n---\n\n## Sample Data Flow\n\n### Creating a Reservation\n\n```csharp\n// 1. Customer (User with Role.Customer)\nvar customer = new User \n{ \n    FirstName = \"John\", \n    Role = UserRole.Customer \n};\n\n// 2. Salon\nvar salon = new HairSalon { Name = \"Premium Cuts\" };\n\n// 3. Staff at Salon\nvar staff = new Staff \n{ \n    User = customer,  // Actually different user\n    HairSalon = salon \n};\n\n// 4. Service at Salon\nvar service = new Service \n{ \n    HairSalon = salon,\n    Name = \"Hair Cut\",\n    Price = 60m\n};\n\n// 5. Reservation\nvar reservation = new Reservation \n{ \n    Customer = customer,\n    Staff = staff,\n    Service = service,\n    ReservationDateTime = new DateTime(2026, 4, 5, 10, 0, 0),\n    Status = ReservationStatus.Confirmed\n};\n\n// 6. The app opens on the Home dashboard.\n\n---\n\n## Data Models\n\nThe system has 6 entity classes and 2 enums, all in `Models/`.\n\n### User\nRepresents all users ‘«ˆ customers, staff, and admins.\n\n```csharp\npublic int Id { get; set; }\npublic string? Email { get; set; }\npublic string? PasswordHash { get; set; }\npublic string? FirstName { get; set; }\npublic string? LastName { get; set; }\npublic string? PhoneNumber { get; set; }\npublic UserRole Role { get; set; }          // Enum: Customer, Staff, Admin\npublic DateTime CreatedAt { get; set; }\n\n// Navigation properties\npublic Staff? Staff { get; set; }                          // 1-to-1 if user is staff\npublic List<Reservation> CustomerReservations { get; set; } // reservations they made\npublic List<Review> Reviews { get; set; }                   // reviews they wrote\n```\n\n### UserRole (Enum)\n```csharp\nCustomer   // Can book reservations\nStaff      // Works at a salon\nAdmin      // Manages the system\n```\n\n### HairSalon\nRepresents a physical salon location.\n\n```csharp\npublic int Id { get; set; }\npublic string? Name { get; set; }\npublic string? Address { get; set; }\npublic string? PhoneNumber { get; set; }\npublic string? Email { get; set; }\npublic DateTime CreatedAt { get; set; }\n\n// Navigation properties\npublic List<Staff> Staff { get; set; }       // all staff at this salon\npublic List<Service> Services { get; set; }  // all services offered here\n```\n\n### Staff\nLinks a User to a HairSalon as an employee.\n\n```csharp\npublic int Id { get; set; }\npublic int UserId { get; set; }       // FK ‘ÊÂ User\npublic int HairSalonId { get; set; }  // FK ‘ÊÂ HairSalon\npublic string? Specialization { get; set; }\npublic decimal HourlyRate { get; set; }\npublic bool IsAvailable { get; set; }\n\n// Navigation properties\npublic User? User { get; set; }\npublic HairSalon? HairSalon { get; set; }\npublic List<Reservation> Reservations { get; set; }  // appointments assigned to them\n```\n\n### Service\nA service offered by a salon (haircut, coloring, etc.).\n\n```csharp\npublic int Id { get; set; }\npublic int HairSalonId { get; set; }  // FK ‘ÊÂ HairSalon\npublic string? Name { get; set; }\npublic string? Description { get; set; }\npublic decimal Price { get; set; }\npublic int DurationMinutes { get; set; }\npublic ServiceCategory Category { get; set; }  // Enum\n\n// Navigation properties\npublic HairSalon? HairSalon { get; set; }\npublic List<Reservation> Reservations { get; set; }\n```\n\n### ServiceCategory (Enum)\n```csharp\nHairCut | Coloring | Styling | Treatment | Beard | Nails | FacialTreatment\n```\n\n### Reservation\nA booking by a customer for a specific service with a specific staff member.\n\n```csharp\npublic int Id { get; set; }\npublic int CustomerId { get; set; }  // FK ‘ÊÂ User\npublic int StaffId { get; set; }     // FK ‘ÊÂ Staff\npublic int ServiceId { get; set; }   // FK ‘ÊÂ Service\npublic DateTime ReservationDateTime { get; set; }\npublic ReservationStatus Status { get; set; }  // Enum\npublic string? Service { get; set; }\npublic List<Review> Reviews { get; set; }\n```\n\n### ReservationStatus (Enum)\n```csharp\nPending     // Waiting for confirmation\nConfirmed   // Appointment confirmed\nCompleted   // Service delivered\nCancelled   // Customer cancelled\nNoShow      // Customer didn't show up\n```\n\n### Review\nA customer's rating and comment for a completed reservation.\n\n```csharp\npublic int Id { get; set; }\npublic int ReservationId { get; set; }  // FK ‘ÊÂ Reservation\npublic int CustomerId { get; set; }     // FK ‘ÊÂ User\npublic int Rating { get; set; }         // 1‘«Ù5\npublic string? Comment { get; set; }\npublic DateTime CreatedAt { get; set; }\n\n// Navigation properties\npublic Reservation? Reservation { get; set; }\npublic User? Customer { get; set; }\n```\n\n---\n\n## Entity Relationships\n\n```\nHairSalon (1) ‘ˆ«‘ˆ«‘ˆ«‘ˆ« (many) Staff ‘ˆ«‘ˆ«‘ˆ«‘ˆ« (many) Reservations ‘ˆ«‘ˆ«‘ˆ«‘ˆ« (many) Reviews\nHairSalon (1) ‘ˆ«‘ˆ«‘ˆ«‘ˆ« (many) Services ‘ˆ«‘ˆ«‘ˆ«‘ˆ«‘ˆ«‘ˆ«‘ˆ«‘ˆ«‘ˆ«‘ˆ«‘ˆ«‘ˆ«‘ˆ«‘ˆú\nUser (1) ‘ˆ«‘ˆ«‘ˆ«‘ˆ«‘ˆ«‘ˆ«‘ˆ«‘ˆ«‘ˆ«‘ˆ«‘ˆ«‘ˆ«‘ˆ«‘ˆ«‘ˆ«‘ˆ«‘ˆ«‘ˆ«‘ˆ«‘ˆ«‘ˆ«‘ˆ«‘ˆ«‘ˆ«‘ˆ«‘ˆ«‘ˆ«‘ˆ« (many) Reservations (as Customer)\nUser (1) ‘ˆ«‘ˆ«‘ˆ«‘ˆ«‘ˆ«‘ˆ«‘ˆ«‘ˆ« (1) Staff\n```\n\n| From | To | Type | Meaning |\n|---|---|---|---|\n| HairSalon | Staff | 1-to-many | A salon employs many staff |\n| HairSalon | Service | 1-to-many | A salon offers many services |\n| User | Staff | 1-to-1 | A staff-role user has one staff profile |\n| User | Reservation | 1-to-many | A customer can have many reservations |\n| User | Review | 1-to-many | A customer can write many reviews |\n| Staff | Reservation | 1-to-many | A staff member handles many reservations |\n| Service | Reservation | 1-to-many | A service can be booked many times |\n| Reservation | Review | 1-to-many | A reservation can receive many reviews |\n\n### How reservations relate back to a salon\n\nThere is no direct `HairSalonId` on `Reservation`. The path is:\n\n```\nHairSalon ‘ÊÂ Staff[] ‘ÊÂ Reservations[]\n```\n\nIn Razor views this is written with `SelectMany`:\n\n```csharp\nvar salonReservations = Model.Staff\n    .SelectMany(s => s.Reservations)\n    .ToList();\n```\n\n---\n\n## Repositories\n\nAll repositories live in `Repositories/` and read from the static `MockDataStore`. They are **not** connected to a database ‘«ˆ all data is hardcoded in memory.\n\n| Repository | Methods |\n|---|---|\n| `MockUserRepository` | `GetAll()`, `GetById(id)`, `GetByRole(role)`, `GetCustomers()`, `GetStaffUsers()`, `GetByEmail(email)` |\n| `MockHairSalonRepository` | `GetAll()`, `GetById(id)`, `GetByName(name)` |\n| `MockStaffRepository` | `GetAll()`, `GetById(id)`, `GetBySalonId(id)`, `GetByUserId(id)`, `GetAvailable()` |\n| `MockServiceRepository` | `GetAll()`, `GetById(id)`, `GetBySalonId(id)`, `GetByCategory(cat)`, `GetByMaxPrice(price)` |\n| `MockReservationRepository` | `GetAll()`, `GetById(id)`, `GetByCustomerId(id)`, `GetByStaffId(id)`, `GetByStatus(status)`, `GetByServiceId(id)` |\n| `MockReviewRepository` | `GetAll()`, `GetById(id)`, `GetByReservationId(id)`, `GetByCustomerId(id)` |\n\n### MockDataStore\n\n`Repositories/MockDataStore.cs` is a static class whose constructor builds all in-memory data: 3 salons, 5 staff members (linked to user accounts), 9 services, 9 reservations, 0 reviews (empty list). All navigation properties are wired up manually (e.g. `salon1.Staff.Add(staffSalon1_1)`).\n\n### Dependency injection\n\nRepositories are registered as singletons in `Program.cs`:\n\n```csharp\nbuilder.Services.AddSingleton<MockUserRepository>();\nbuilder.Services.AddSingleton<MockHairSalonRepository>();\nbuilder.Services.AddSingleton<MockStaffRepository>();\nbuilder.Services.AddSingleton<MockServiceRepository>();\nbuilder.Services.AddSingleton<MockReservationRepository>();\nbuilder.Services.AddSingleton<MockReviewRepository>();\n```\n\nThey are injected into controllers via constructor injection:\n\n```csharp\npublic class UsersController : Controller\n{\n    private readonly MockUserRepository _userRepo;\n\n    public UsersController(MockUserRepository userRepo)\n    {\n        _userRepo = userRepo;\n    }\n}\n```\n\n---\n\n## Controllers and Views\n\nEach entity has its own controller with `Index` (list) and `Details` (single item) actions.\n\n| Controller | Route | What it shows |\n|---|---|---|\n| `HomeController` | `/` | Dashboard with counts |\n| `UsersController` | `/Users` | All users table + detail page |\n| `HairSalonsController` | `/HairSalons` | All salons + detail (with staff, services, reservations, reviews) |\n| `StaffController` | `/Staff` | All staff + detail (with reservations) |\n| `ServicesController` | `/Services` | All services + detail (with reservations) |\n| `ReservationsController` | `/Reservations` | All reservations + detail |\n| `ReviewsController` | `/Reviews` | All reviews + detail |\n\n### How data flows from controller to view\n\n1. Controller calls the repository: `var users = _userRepo.GetAll();`\n2. Passes the model to the view: `return View(users);`\n3. View declares the model type at the top: `@model List<manage_my_hairsaloon.Models.User>`\n4. View iterates or displays the data with Razor syntax: `@user.FirstName`\n\nExample for a detail page:\n\n```csharp\n// Controller\npublic IActionResult Details(int id)\n{\n    var salon = _salonRepo.GetById(id);\n    if (salon == null) return NotFound();\n    return View(salon);       // passes HairSalon object to view\n}\n```\n\n```html\n<!-- View -->\n@model manage_my_hairsaloon.Models.HairSalon\n\n<h1>@Model.Name</h1>\n<p>@Model.Address</p>\n\n@foreach (var staff in Model.Staff)\n{\n    <p>@staff.User?.FirstName ‘«ˆ @staff.Specialization</p>\n}\n```\n\n### Views folder structure\n\n```\nViews/\n  Home/           Index.cshtml (dashboard)\n  Users/          Index.cshtml, Details.cshtml\n  HairSalons/     Index.cshtml, Details.cshtml\n  Staff/          Index.cshtml, Details.cshtml\n  Services/       Index.cshtml, Details.cshtml\n  Reservations/   Index.cshtml, Details.cshtml\n  Reviews/        Index.cshtml, Details.cshtml\n  Shared/         _Layout.cshtml (nav + page shell)\n```\n\n### Back navigation (returnUrl pattern)\n\nWhen navigating from a detail page to a child detail page, a `returnUrl` query parameter is passed:\n\n```html\n<a asp-controller=\"Staff\" asp-action=\"Details\"\n   asp-route-id=\"@staff.Id\"\n   asp-route-returnUrl=\"@Context.Request.PathBase@Context.Request.Path\">\n   Details\n</a>\n```\n\nThe target detail page reads it and uses it for the back link:\n\n```csharp\nvar returnUrl = Context.Request.Query[\"returnUrl\"].FirstOrDefault();\n```\n\n```html\n@if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(returnUrl) && Url.IsLocalUrl(returnUrl))\n{\n    <a href=\"@returnUrl\">‘Ê… Back</a>\n}\nelse\n{\n    <a asp-controller=\"Staff\" asp-action=\"Index\">‘Ê… Back to Staff</a>\n}\n```\n\n`Url.IsLocalUrl()` validates the URL to prevent open-redirect attacks.\n\n---\n\n## UI / Styling\n\nAll styling lives in `wwwroot/css/site.css`. {"timestamp":"2026-05-06T15:57:01.609Z","hook_event_name":"PreToolUse","session_id":"b5dc0019-d0bb-46ee-9d03-d78587d8b400","transcript_path":"c:\\Users\\misla\\AppData\\Roaming\\Code\\User\\workspaceStorage\\f442918b69b7be1a95b300561227d406\\GitHub.copilot-chat\\transcripts\\b5dc0019-d0bb-46ee-9d03-d78587d8b400.jsonl","tool_name":"create_file","tool_input":{"filePath":"c:\\Users\\misla\\source\\repos\\manage-my-hairsaloon\\.github\\skills\\form-skill\\SKILL.md","content":"---\nname: form-skill\ndescription: \"Use when: creating web forms for the manage-my-hairsaloon ASP.NET Core MVC app. Covers GET filter forms and POST create/edit/delete forms. Handles wiring controller actions, repository calls, ModelState validation (server-side), and Razor view markup. Use for any task that involves collecting input from the user and persisting it to the database or filtering data.\"\nargument-hint: \"Describe the form to create, e.g. 'create reservation form' or 'edit service form'\"\n---\n\n# Form Skill ‘«ˆ manage-my-hairsaloon\n\nHandles end-to-end form creation for this ASP.NET Core MVC app: Razor view markup, controller actions (GET + POST), repository layer calls, and server-side ModelState validation.\n\n## Project Conventions\n\n| Convention | Value |\n|---|---|\n| Namespace | `manage_my_hairsaloon` |\n| ORM | Entity Framework Core 8 via `AppDbContext` |\n| Data access | Repository pattern ‘«ˆ always go through the interface, never inject `AppDbContext` into controllers |\n| Route convention | `{Controller}/{Action}/{id?}` (default) ‘«ˆ use `[HttpGet(\"...\")]` for custom slug routes |\n| Validation | Server-side only: Data Annotations on models + `ModelState.IsValid` in POST actions |\n| View location | `Views/{ControllerName}/{ActionName}.cshtml` |\n| Shared layout | `Views/Shared/_Layout.cshtml` ‘«ˆ all views inherit it via `_ViewStart.cshtml` |\n| CSS classes | `btn-outline-brass`, `input-barbershop`, `table-barbershop`, `badge-brass`, `card-barbershop`, `filter-bar` |\n\n## When to Use This Skill\n\n- Creating a **Create** form (`GET` renders empty form, `POST` saves to DB)\n- Creating an **Edit** form (`GET` loads existing record, `POST` updates DB)\n- Adding a **Delete** confirmation + action\n- Adding a **filter/search** form (GET only, calls read-only repository methods)\n- Wiring a new form action to an existing or new repository method\n\n---\n\n## Step-by-Step: POST Form (Create / Edit / Delete)\n\n### Step 1 ‘«ˆ Add Data Annotations to the Model\n\nAdd validation attributes to the model class. Models are in `Models/`.\n\n```csharp\nusing System.ComponentModel.DataAnnotations;\n\npublic class HairSalon\n{\n    public int Id { get; set; }\n\n    [Required(ErrorMessage = \"Name is required.\")]\n    [StringLength(100)]\n    public string? Name { get; set; }\n\n    [Required]\n    public string? Address { get; set; }\n\n    [Phone]\n    public string? PhoneNumber { get; set; }\n\n    [EmailAddress]\n    public string? Email { get; set; }\n\n    public DateTime CreatedAt { get; set; }\n    // navigation properties stay as-is\n}\n```\n\n> Only annotate scalar properties. Never annotate navigation properties (`List<Staff>`, etc.).\n\n### Step 2 ‘«ˆ Add Repository Write Methods\n\nCheck [repository-api.md](./references/repository-api.md) to see what already exists.  \nIf the needed method (e.g. `Add`, `Update`, `Delete`) is missing:\n\n1. Add the method signature to the **interface** in `Repositories/I{Entity}Repository.cs`\n2. Implement it in `Repositories/{Entity}Repository.cs` using `AppDbContext`\n\n**Standard write method patterns:**\n\n```csharp\n// Interface\nvoid Add(HairSalon salon);\nvoid Update(HairSalon salon);\nvoid Delete(int id);\n\n// Implementation (inject AppDbContext via constructor)\npublic void Add(HairSalon salon)\n{\n    _context.HairSalons.Add(salon);\n    _context.SaveChanges();\n}\n\npublic void Update(HairSalon salon)\n{\n    _context.HairSalons.Update(salon);\n    _context.SaveChanges();\n}\n\npublic void Delete(int id)\n{\n    var salon = _context.HairSalons.Find(id);\n    if (salon != null)\n    {\n        _context.HairSalons.Remove(salon);\n        _context.SaveChanges();\n    }\n}\n```\n\n> `SaveChanges()` must be called explicitly ‘«ˆ EF does not auto-save.\n\n### Step 3 ‘«ˆ Add Controller Actions\n\nSee [controller-patterns.md](./references/controller-patterns.md) for the full patterns.\n\n**Create (GET + POST):**\n```csharp\n// GET: /HairSalons/Create\npublic IActionResult Create()\n{\n    // Populate ViewBag dropdowns here if needed (see Step 3a)\n    return View();\n}\n\n// POST: /HairSalons/Create\n[HttpPost]\n[ValidateAntiForgeryToken]\npublic IActionResult Create(HairSalon model)\n{\n    if (!ModelState.IsValid)\n        return View(model);   // re-render form with validation errors\n\n    model.CreatedAt = DateTime.UtcNow;\n    _salonRepo.Add(model);\n    return RedirectToAction(nameof(Index));\n}\n```\n\n**Edit (GET + POST):**\n```csharp\n// GET: /HairSalons/Edit/5\npublic IActionResult Edit(int id)\n{\n    var salon = _salonRepo.GetById(id);\n    if (salon == null) return NotFound();\n    return View(salon);\n}\n\n// POST: /HairSalons/Edit/5\n[HttpPost]\n[ValidateAntiForgeryToken]\npublic IActionResult Edit(int id, HairSalon model)\n{\n    if (id != model.Id) return BadRequest();\n    if (!ModelState.IsValid)\n        return View(model);\n\n    _salonRepo.Update(model);\n    return RedirectToAction(nameof(Index));\n}\n```\n\n**Delete (GET confirmation + POST):**\n```csharp\n// GET: /HairSalons/Delete/5\npublic IActionResult Delete(int id)\n{\n    var salon = _salonRepo.GetById(id);\n    if (salon == null) return NotFound();\n    return View(salon);\n}\n\n// POST: /HairSalons/Delete/5\n[HttpPost, ActionName(\"Delete\")]\n[ValidateAntiForgeryToken]\npublic IActionResult DeleteConfirmed(int id)\n{\n    _salonRepo.Delete(id);\n    return RedirectToAction(nameof(Index));\n}\n```\n\n#### Step 3a ‘«ˆ Dropdown Lists (SelectLists for FK fields)\n\nWhen a form field is a foreign key (e.g. `HairSalonId` on a `Service`), pass the list via `ViewBag`:\n\n```csharp\n// In GET action, before return View():\nViewBag.Salons = new SelectList(_salonRepo.GetAll(), \"Id\", \"Name\");\n// In POST action, if ModelState.IsValid fails, repopulate before return View(model):\nViewBag.Salons = new SelectList(_salonRepo.GetAll(), \"Id\", \"Name\", model.HairSalonId);\n```\n\nFor enum fields (`ServiceCategory`, `ReservationStatus`), use:\n```csharp\nViewBag.Categories = new SelectList(Enum.GetValues<ServiceCategory>());\n```\n\n### Step 4 ‘«ˆ Create the Razor View\n\n**Create / Edit form template:**\n```html\n@model manage_my_hairsaloon.Models.HairSalon\n@{\n    ViewData[\"Title\"] = \"Create Salon\";\n}\n\n<div class=\"page-header\">\n    <h1>Create Salon</h1>\n</div>\n\n<div class=\"card-barbershop\" style=\"max-width:560px;\">\n    <form asp-action=\"Create\" method=\"post\">\n        @Html.AntiForgeryToken()\n\n        <div asp-validation-summary=\"ModelOnly\" class=\"text-danger\" style=\"margin-bottom:1rem;\"></div>\n\n        <div class=\"form-group\" style=\"margin-bottom:1rem;\">\n            <label asp-for=\"Name\"></label>\n            <input asp-for=\"Name\" class=\"input-barbershop\" />\n            <span asp-validation-for=\"Name\" class=\"text-danger\" style=\"font-size:0.8rem;\"></span>\n        </div>\n\n        <div class=\"form-group\" style=\"margin-bottom:1rem;\">\n            <label asp-for=\"Address\"></label>\n            <input asp-for=\"Address\" class=\"input-barbershop\" />\n            <span asp-validation-for=\"Address\" class=\"text-danger\" style=\"font-size:0.8rem;\"></span>\n        </div>\n\n        <!-- FK dropdown example -->\n        @* <div class=\"form-group\" style=\"margin-bottom:1rem;\">\n            <label asp-for=\"HairSalonId\">Salon</label>\n            <select asp-for=\"HairSalonId\" asp-items=\"ViewBag.Salons\" class=\"input-barbershop\">\n                <option value=\"\">-- Select --</option>\n            </select>\n            <span asp-validation-for=\"HairSalonId\" class=\"text-danger\" style=\"font-size:0.8rem;\"></span>\n        </div> *@\n\n        <div style=\"display:flex; gap:0.75rem; margin-top:1.5rem;\">\n            <button type=\"submit\" class=\"btn-outline-brass\">Save</button>\n            <a asp-action=\"Index\" class=\"back-link\" style=\"align-self:center;\">Cancel</a>\n        </div>\n    </form>\n</div>\n```\n\n**Delete confirmation view template:**\n```html\n@model manage_my_hairsaloon.Models.HairSalon\n@{\n    ViewData[\"Title\"] = \"Delete Salon\";\n}\n\n<div class=\"page-header\">\n    <h1>Delete Salon</h1>\n</div>\n\n<div class=\"card-barbershop\" style=\"max-width:480px;\">\n    <p>Are you sure you want asp-action=\"Index\" class=\"back-link\" style=\"align-self:center;\">Cancel</a>\n        </div>\n    </form>\n</div>\n```\n\n---\n\n## Step-by-Step: GET Filter Form\n\nGET filter forms call existing read-only repository methods and re-render an Index-style view.\n\n### Controller action pattern\n\n```csharp\n// Attribute route (custom slug) ‘«ˆ use [HttpGet] not [Route]\n[HttpGet(\"services/category/{category}\")]\npublic IActionResult ByCategory(ServiceCategory category)\n{\n    var services = _serviceRepo.GetByCategory(category);\n    return View(\"Index\", services);  // reuse existing Index view\n}\n```\n\nFor query-string-based filters (no slug):\n```csharp\n// Convention route: /Services/Filter?maxPrice=50\npublic IActionResult Filter(decimal? maxPrice)\n{\n    var services = maxPrice.HasValue\n        ? _serviceRepo.GetByMaxPrice(maxPrice.Value)\n        : _serviceRepo.GetAll();\n    return View(\"Index\", services);\n}\n```\n\n### View: add filter controls above the table\n\nUse plain `<a href=\"...\">` links for slug-based filters (tag helpers can't generate custom attribute routes):\n```html\n<div class=\"filter-bar\" style=\"display:flex; gap:0.5rem; flex-wrap:wrap; margin-bottom:1rem;\">\n    <a href=\"/Services/Index\" class=\"btn-outline-brass\">All</a>\n    <a href=\"/services/category/HairCut\" class=\"btn-outline-brass\">Haircut</a>\n    <a href=\"/services/category/Beard\" class=\"btn-outline-brass\">Beard</a>\n</div>\n```\n\nFor query-string filters, use a standard `<form method=\"get\">`:\n```html\n<form method=\"get\" asp-action=\"Filter\" style=\"display:flex; gap:0.5rem; margin-bottom:1rem;\">\n    <input type=\"number\" name=\"maxPrice\" class=\"input-barbershop\" placeholder=\"Max price...\" />\n    <button type=\"submit\" class=\"btn-outline-brass\">Filter</button>\n</form>\n```\n\n---\n\n## FK Relationship Rules\n\nWhen creating records that have FK fields, routing and can make endpoints unreachable.\n\n## URL Casing\n\nThe project uses **PascalCase** for controller/action segments in convention routes:\n- ‘ù˘ `/Staff/Available`\n- ‘ù˘ All use `[HttpGet(\"...\")]` ‘«ˆ **never `[Route]`** ‘«ˆ to avoid conflicts with convention routing.\n\n| URL | Controller action | Description |\n|---|---|---|\n| `/services/category/{category}` | `ServicesController.ByCategory` | Services filtered by `ServiceCategory` enum |\n| `/Staff/Available` | `StaffController.Available` | All staff where `IsAvailable == true` |\n| `/Staff/Available` (salon-scoped) | `StaffController.AvailableBySalon` | ‘«ˆ see below |\n| `/reservations/status/{status}` | `ReservationsController.ByStatus` | Reservations filtered by `ReservationStatus` enum |\n| `/salons/search/{name}` | `HairSalonsController.Search` | Salon found by exact name |\n| `/salons/{salonId}/staff/available` | `StaffController.AvailableBySalon` | Available staff for a specific salon |\n| `/salons/{salonId}/reservations/status/{status}` | `ReservationsController.BySalonAndStatus` | Reservations for a salon + status combo |\n| `/salons/{salonId}/NewReservations` | `HairSalonsController.NewReservation` (GET + POST) | Reservation booking form |\n\n### Why `[HttpGet]` not `[Route]`\n\n`[Route]` on an individual action doesn't restrict the HTTP method, which causes it to conflict with the default convention routing and makes endpoints unreachable. `[HttpGet(\"...\")]` specifies both path and method.\n\n```csharp\n// Correct\n[HttpGet(\"services/category/{category}\")]\npublic IActionResult ByCategory(ServiceCategory category) { ... }\n\n// Wrong ‘«ˆ can make the action unreachable\n[Route(\"services/category/{category}\")]\npublic IActionResult ByCategory(ServiceCategory category) { ... }\n```\n\n### Enum binding in routes\n\nASP.NET Core automatically binds enum names in URL segments. The enum name must match exactly (case-insensitive):\n\n```\n/services/category/HairCut    ‘ÊÂ ServiceCategory.HairCut  ‘ùÙ\n/reservations/status/Confirmed ‘ÊÂ ReservationStatus.Confirmed  ‘ùÙ\n```\n\n---\n\n## UI Filter Controls\n\nEach index page has filter controls so users don't need to type URLs manually.\n\n| Page | Controls |\n|---|---|\n| `Services/Index` | Category filter pill buttons (All + one per `ServiceCategory`) |\n| `Staff/Index` | \"All Staff\" / \"Available Only\" buttons |\n| `Reservations/Index` | Status filter pill buttons (All + one per `ReservationStatus`) |\n| `HairSalons/Index` | Live text filter (JS `oninput`) ‘«ˆ filters table rows by salon name client-side |\n| `HairSalons/Details` | \"Available Staff Only\" link + per-status reservation filter buttons scoped to that salon |\n\nFilter buttons that target custom attribute routes use plain `<a href=\"...\">` links (tag helpers cannot generate custom attribute route URLs):\n```html\n<a href=\"/services/category/HairCut\" class=\"btn-outline-brass\">Haircut</a>\n```\n\nSalon-scoped filter buttons use the model ID:\n```html\n<a href=\"/salons/@Model.Id/staff/available\" class=\"btn-outline-brass\">Available Staff Only</a>\n```\n\n---\n\n## New Reservation Form\n\nAccessible from each salon's detail page via the **\"Make a Reservation\"** button.\n\n### URL\n- `GET  /salons/{salonId}/NewReservations` ‘«ˆ renders the form (date step)\n- `GET  /salons/{salonId}/NewReservations?date=2026-05-10` ‘«ˆ shows available time slots for that date\n- `POST /salons/{salonId}/NewReservations` ‘«ˆ saves the reservation\n\n### Two-step flow\n\n**Step 1 ‘«ˆ Pick a date**  \nA GET form submits `?date=YYYY-MM-DD`. The controller calls `GetBySalonIdAndDate` to find reservations that day, then computes which 1-hour slots (09:00‘«Ù18:00) still have a free staff member.\n\n**Step 2 ‘«ˆ Complete the form**  \nOnly shown when `AvailableHours` is non-empty. The user selects:\n- A time slot (radio buttons styled as brass pill buttons)\n- A service (dropdown: Name ‘«ˆ price, duration)\n- A staff member (dropdown: First Last)\n- A customer (dropdown ‘«ˆ temporary until authentication is added)\n- Optional notes\n\n### Time-slot availability logic\nA slot is available when the number of staff already booked at that hour is less than the total number of available staff at the salon:\n```csharp\nvm.AvailableHours = WorkHours\n    .Where(h => !bookedByHour.ContainsKey(h) || bookedByHour[h] < staffIds.Count)\n    .ToList();\n```\nCancelled reservations are excluded from the booked count.\n\n### ViewModel (`ViewModels/NewReservationViewModel.cs`)\nCombines display data (populated by controller) and form input (validated on POST):\n```csharp\n// Display data\nHairSalon Salon\nList<Service> Services\nList<Staff> AvailableStaff\nList<User> Customers\nList<int> AvailableHours\n\n// Form input (validated)\nint ServiceId        [Required]\nint StaffId          [Required]\nint CustomerId       [Required]\nDateTime? Notes        [StringLength(500)]\n```\n\n### Backend wiring\n- `IReservationRepository.GetBySalonIdAndDate(salonId, date)` ‘«ˆ new method added\n- `IReservationRepository.Add(reservation)` ‘«ˆ new method added\n- `HairSalonsController` now injects 5 repositories: `IHairSalonRepository`, `IServiceRepository`, `IStaffRepository`, `IReservationRepository`, `IUserRepository`\n\n---\n\n## UI / Styling","oldString":"---\n\n## UI / Styling"},"tool_use_id":"toolu_bdrk_01Hg2EhFzJias5LV9oCwZa7i__vscode-1778006032548","cwd":"c:\\Users\\misla\\source\\repos\\manage-my-hairsaloon"}
